reviews.comment: his lectures can be pretty boring, but if you have prior knowledge of java, this class can be very fun. homeworks take veryy long though, so be sure to do them early

The course was disorganized, and the instructor, while nice, wasn't the best fit for an intro class. I recommend relying on the TAs, as they were the most helpful. Take advantage of extra credit to improve your grade. Group projects were more of a hassle than useful. Also, don't use ChatGPT—all the TAs can tell.

Hard to understand and INCREDIBLY disorganized. Grades for coding assignments were put in months after they were turned in, so you don't even know how you are doing in the class until it is too late to drop the class. The class itself isn't super difficult, but his lectures are not very helpful. TA's are very knowledgeable and helpful though.

He's a passionate professor and is happy to explain things in depth and talk outside of class, unfortunately, this class was the least organized I've ever taken. HWs had many mistakes and typos, multiple times we got no test cases or if they were posted they were posted only a day or two before it was due. Our exam review was posted late also.

i got an A because i did all of the extra credit he literally doesnt teach, i still dont know what a scnr is he is a terrible professor -10/10 do not take i dont know how i got an A, the class itself though is structured so well bc he stole the format from Lightfoot, just try to avoid at all costs and he has an accent DO NOT TAKE

Not a bad professor by any means but not outstanding either. He has very straight-to-the-point lectures, jumping between lecture slides and real coding examples. His explanations are okay, but he's always open to giving additional clarification and feedback as long as you ask for it.

Was his first semester teaching. Compared to other CSCE120/121 professors, his lecture/slides were not the best. However, he was extremely helpful and kind in office hours and tries his best to help students debug/understand homework, which is a major part of this course. Towards the end, his lectures showed improvement compared to the beginning.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mahmood's "class engagement" assignments that he makes students do during each lecture only loosely relate to the content covered in classes, and he is not the worst but also not the best at explaining concepts, especially for exams. The lab portion is out of his power and you are better off asking TAs for help on the weekly homework assignments.
